Lemma 2 follows by upward closure: any e >= 0 computes the same copy by composing with a functional computing 0 from e. No Ulm theory is needed and the draft honestly limits the claim to computable groups and the stated spectrum definition, distinguishing rigorous proof from experimental evidence. Boundary conditions (computability of both groups, ordinary Turing jump) are verified.
